iterations.summary: The external source is bdfinst/agentic-dev-team at commit 842286b, including the dev-team and security-assessment plugins. The comparison also uses the local public skills checkout at 13cb428 and Adyton skills checkout at 49b171b. Their READMEs identify the stated workflows, installation boundaries, and tool dependencies; code-level claims require separate research.

Seven neutral questions cover the upstream development and security plugins, the public and Adyton collections, hooks, evaluations, and cross-agent/project boundaries. The research phase should distinguish executable behavior, prompt contracts, fixture evidence, and observed live outcomes at pinned revisions.

The upstream dev-team combines Claude-specific workflow instructions, a narrower Python dispatcher, project-local hook state and paid opt-in evaluations; security-assessment combines deterministic scanner adapters with agent judgment and report generation. Public skills already implement portable phase skills, artifact-bound approvals, verification, review and evidence, while Adyton additionally documents paired-repository Jira delivery. The notable current-state distinctions are hook enforcement scope, deep tool-first security assessment, cross-repository task contracts, and the different task-artifact formats in the two local collections.

This epic proposes thirteen public-skills children and five Adyton companion changes, ordered behind human review. It adds measured outcomes, opt-in tool-first security, portable publication proof, runtime capability checks, and bounded orchestration without replacing existing delivery or storage formats. The public epic creates only public-repository children; a separate Adyton epic must be opened in its own repository after approval.

Thirteen public child tasks and GitHub issues were created from the approved epic plan. Four independent wave-one children can start in fresh worktrees. Later waves wait for their dependency pull requests to merge; five Adyton companion changes need a separate epic in that repository.
Independent full-diff review and correction re-reviews found no remaining actionable major defect at public source commit 6ade855b.
Clean full-diff source review at 6ade855b plus direct review of the subsequent evidence hygiene and immutable receipt at 4159c094.

Fifteen focused cases and live draft/ready publication probes passed at 591c40eb; scanner coverage was correctly reported incomplete, not clean. Original CLI output is anonymously readable at the hosted capture and linked in PR #141's distinct evidence comment.

Close the measured delivery and security gaps against `bdfinst/agentic-dev-team` without replacing portable phase skills, defaulting to a security-agent swarm, or claiming an unmeasured cost advantage.
